scope: Renewed source-specific follow-up for all 33 eligible national chamber identities in 22 European groups, excluding the separately reviewed national-gap batch. Every record remains partial.

method.sources: Current ordinary public HTTP GET, official web source readings and two selected source-player Chromium checks. Catalogue entries supply leads only, not fresh facts.
method.distinctions: HTTP/page/provenance, source-described player features, dated programme metadata, decoded video and legal permission are separate evidence dimensions. Access failures do not mean absence. No chamber inherits another chamber’s coverage.
method.browser_environment: Browser plugin unavailable; installed Playwright 1.64.0 Chromium, 1440 x 1000, normal source-native player, muted playback; screenshots stored outside repo and inspected.
method.safety: No outreach, CAPTCHA interaction, TLS/authentication bypass, private API, media download or YouTube manifest extraction. Terms PDF/document reads only; no raw HTML/session credentials saved to repo.

material_findings: French Assembly separate multimedia prior-agreement rule conflicts with a broad existing catalogue summary; root notified, canonical data unchanged by this report.
Czech House expressly documents HLS external-player and iframe use. Czech Senate dated 21 October record decoded at source offset and after seek.
Finnish 23 October initial video decoded but seek sample stalled; timezone presentation differs across source surfaces.
Danish TV broad conditional licence, Swiss chamber-specific embeds, Irish separate broadcast-licence requirement and supplied iframe workflow distinguished.
Norway published redistribution notice is technically dated and agreement-based; do not treat it as a blanket arbitrary-manifest licence.
Spain official linked notice recorded only as current operational context.

at.conditions: Conditional uses for political reporting, political education and private noncommercial purposes; audiovisual items must carry Parliament Directorate copyright. Preserve source and creator attribution; third-party rights and item restrictions remain. Commercial or other uses need separate consent.

cz.conditions: This official House page publishes HLS for alternative players/apps and provides external iframe instructions. These specific technical uses are documented; no general recording, rebroadcast or audiovisual derivative licence established here.

dk.conditions: TV licence grants worldwide royalty-free nonexclusive reproduction, public distribution/performance/communication across media. Preserve licence, credits and notices; no restrictive sublicensing/DRM or endorsement. Copied embed code must remain intact. Only necessary format changes and specified contextual cropping are allowed; no altered sound, overlays, collages or misleading edits. Speakers retain rights over collections of their contributions.

fi.conditions: Parliament-produced plenary and public-committee audiovisual material may be distributed and used unchanged, respecting context and source. Credit Parliament, or Yle for Yle-produced live coverage. Excluded marks/third-party works and any item-specific conditions remain; no unrestricted editing licence inferred.

fr-an.conditions: Hyperlinks are permitted subject to context restrictions. The general public-document/debate reproduction provisions do not remove the separate prior-agreement rule for graphics, photographs and multimedia. Portal download help describes a supply workflow, not an independent republication licence.

fr-sen.conditions: Noncommercial hyperlinks/RSS require clear Senate identification and prior webmaster notification. Video reuse is nonexclusive, with Senate logo throughout, source credit in credits, and no reframing or image manipulation. Separate audio reuse requires agreement and excludes commercial exploitation. Parliamentary-document rules do not automatically cover every third-party asset.

de.conditions: Archive download/embed is offered under these conditions; live supply is on request. Free parliamentary reporting, education and culture uses preserve Parliament attribution, context and third-party rights; commercial advertising is excluded. Limited excerpts/voiceovers/name titles and accessibility additions are allowed, wider editing needs written permission; pass conditions onward.

gr.conditions: Partial website-content republication must preserve content and cite source, date and link. Third-party content and special terms are excluded. This does not establish an unrestricted full-channel relay or direct-player licence.

ie.conditions: Most qualifying non-broadcast information uses the Open Data PSI licence/CC BY 4.0 with attribution, notice and licence reference. Broadcast proceedings of both Houses and committees have a distinct PSI licence requiring application and permission, political balance, source credit and use restrictions. Separately published live iframe instructions offer chamber/room-specific embeds with credit and coverage rules; they do not establish general raw-stream redistribution.

it-camera.conditions: Text and multimedia use/copy/distribution is permitted for noncommercial public-information purposes with integrity, source, personality and other rights respected. Alteration/derivatives require written permission; no logo licence or blanket commercial use.

lu.conditions: Unless otherwise indicated, site information may be reproduced noncommercially with express source credit. Multimedia/direct-channel scope, third-party assets and item exceptions still need resolution before external player/relay use.

nl-house.source_title: Licentievoorwaarden audiovisueel materiaal Tweede Kamer, 1 May 2019
nl-house.conditions: The English generic notice differs from the current Dutch disclaimer and linked audiovisual licence. Root independently inspected all four licence pages: conditional media-specific use includes other users for journalism/free expression/education/research, with source/copyright/licence credit, no commercial promotion, context/integrity and third-party limits, and destruction of acquired raw material within one month except incorporated licensed works. See the separate Netherlands AV report for primary review and exact conditions.
nl-house.review_provenance: Root’s independent full four-page read; cross-reference reports/discovery/2026-10-24-service-review-netherlands-av-licence.json. This subagent’s ordinary intake GET had returned 503.

no.conditions: Published notice last updated 9 February 2018 requires an agreement for redistribution and designates a dedicated restricted Qbrick publication point. Noncommercial use, source credit and archive/reporting time limits apply. Legacy Flash/RTMP details are dated and do not approve an arbitrary current manifest.

pt.conditions: Assembly claims ownership of its produced material, without prejudice to deputies’ copyright; publication or commercialisation requires prior assent from its President under the quoted statutory provision. A 2015 Web TV description offers social sharing but does not supply a general AV reuse licence.
